classification: Explicitly post-hoc, paper-inspired descriptive inspection, separate from frozen main outcomes, model selection and hyperparameter decisions.

covariance.centering: Centre R across actors separately for each unit: Z_bj=R_bj-mu_j. Use a reference-row subtraction before mean removal to make identical-row zero variance exact.
covariance.sample_covariance: C=Z^T Z/(B-1), with B=64, H=128; report its nonnegative eigenvalue spectrum and mean diagonal variance.
covariance.rank_bound: At most min(H,B-1)=63 for the centred terminal sample, regardless of model capacity.
covariance.roundoff: Compute eigenvalues in float64, use relative zero tolerance eps64*max(B,H)*largest_eigenvalue, set magnitudes within that tolerance to zero, reject materially negative eigenvalues, and report tolerance and numerical rank.
covariance.entropy_effective_rank: exp(-sum_{p_i>0} p_i log p_i), p_i=lambda_i/sum_j lambda_j; all-zero spectrum gives 0. This is entropy rank of the covariance spectrum.
covariance.not_measured: No trajectory feature matrix or task-conditioned representation rank is computed.

phase_context.source: Saved world tensor dictionary at the same completed-action boundary as saved_h; no new observation/action is generated.
phase_context.timing_alignment: saved_h has consumed the last observation and generated its action; the saved world flags already reflect that action, but its resulting one-shot receipt has not entered h until the next tick. An inactive world slot can therefore have just completed, rather than implying a quiescent hidden state.
phase_context.occupancy: Count enabled slots, active slots, raw started flags, active-and-started slots, inactive slots, unstarted-feasible, unstarted-missed-start, processing, legal-finish and active-past-deadline categories. Use the frozen world's 1e-6 timing tolerance.
phase_context.actor_mixture: Report histograms across the 64 actors of the number of active jobs and active-and-started jobs, plus actors with no active job. Report raw started flags separately from active-and-started flags; the frozen world clears started on accepted FINISH, while inactivity can also arise through expiry.
phase_context.purpose: Expose quiet/active and heterogeneous task-phase mixtures in the one terminal snapshot; do not treat these actors as 64 independent training replicates.

activity.activity: R_bj=tanh(saved_h_bj), computed in float64 from the single final live hidden snapshot.
activity.mean: Overall signed mean and per-unit mean mu_j=mean_b R_bj; also report RMS of mu to avoid cancellation in the signed mean.
activity.within_actor_variance: mean_b mean_j (R_bj - mean_k R_bk)^2; population variance across units within each actor, then averaged across actors.
activity.within_actor_centred_batch_variance: First A_bj=R_bj-mean_k R_bk. Then mean_j sum_b(A_bj-mean_c A_cj)^2/(B-1). This is distinct from the unmodified R covariance below.
activity.saturation: Fraction of all B*H activity values with abs(R_bj)>0.95; strict threshold fixed here before inspecting final states.
activity.common_mode: mean_vector_energy=sum_j mu_j^2; uncentred_activity_energy=mean_b sum_j R_bj^2; common_mode_energy_fraction=mean_vector_energy/uncentred_activity_energy, defined as 0 when both are zero. Descriptive relevance to the uncentred coactivity rule, not task utility.

limitations: These are post-hoc descriptive correlates, not prespecified main outcomes or a selection criterion.
A single heterogeneous terminal snapshot is not a representation matrix over time or a task-conditioned memory test.
Lower derivative, saturation, covariance concentration or effective rank alone does not establish causal loss of plasticity, forgetting, useless units or a need for reinitialization.
Cross-arm state spectra can differ because of their actual task phases and own actions as well as learned weights.
The common-mode statistic does not measure semantic overlap, cross-experience association or unit importance.
This does not reproduce the paper's full longitudinal plasticity experiment or infer long-term plasticity loss from one distribution transition.
